p: This produce is konam upon me, … it is konam upon my mouth,
This produce is konam upon me, or it is konam upon my mouth,
or of anything that grows from it.
with regard to an item whose seeds cease
with regard to an item whose seeds do not cease … is prohibited
with regard to an item whose seeds do not cease after it is sown, e.g., bulbs, which flower and enter into a foliage period and repeat the process, it is prohibited

p: I will not eat until Passover,
